description: Main window permissions. Deliberately reduced to the strict minimum (CLAUDE.md §8): no shell, no filesystem read or write, no network plugin. `dialog:default` opens the native picker and returns a path — reading that path is the backend's job, which is what keeps the WebView unable to name a file of its own choosing. Every later addition must be justified in review — a capability granted 'for later' is attack surface acquired for nothing in return.
